verdict.rationale: A live probe of ReadMe's own hub found its llms.txt (HTTP 200) telling readers to "Append .md to any documentation page URL," which is the story's exact mechanism. ReadMe also positions its hubs as "agent-ready" and scores published pages against an Agent-Friendly Docs spec. Missing for 10: a first-party feature doc confirming every customer-published page serves .md, a direct fetch of a .md page URL showing clean markdown, and the rest of the truncated llms.txt instruction.
